examples.text: sataṃ sahassāni'pi dhuttakānaṃ, idh'āgatā tādisakā bhaveyyuṃ, lomaṃ na iñjāmi na santasāmi, na māra bhāyāmi tam'ekikā'pi.

13701.commentary: (MNa) yadidaṃ idhāgamanāyā'ti yo ayaṃ idh'āgamanāya vāro, taṃ, bhante, cirassam'akāsī''ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya. nisīdatu, bhante, bhagavā, idaṃ āsanaṃ paññattan'ti.
idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

13703.meaning1: possesses here; achieves here; attains here
13703.commentary: (THa) tasmā hi paññā'va dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānam'idh'ādhigacchatī'ti paññā'va dhanato pāsaṃsatarā, yāya paññāya vosānaṃ bhavassa pariyosānabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ adhigacchati.

examples.text: satta c'ussade idh'ādhigacchati, hatthapādamudutañ'ca vindati, āhu byañjananimittakovidā, khajjabhojjarasalābhitāya naṃ.
tasmā hi paññā'va dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānam'idh'ādhigacchati, abyositattā hi bhav'ābhavesu, pāpāni kammāni karoti mohā.

13704.meaning1: here Ānanda; in this regard Ānanda

examples.text: idh'ānanda, bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti.

idh'ānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati

13705.meaning1: arrived here; reached here; come here

examples.text: ayaṃ kho so, bhante, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho idh'ānuppatto, aparis'āvacaraṃ pana naṃ karotha, gokāṇaṃ pariyantacāriniṃ karotha, ekapañhen'eva naṃ saṃsādetha, tucchakumbhī'va naṃ orodhethā'ti.
taṃ katvāna ito cuto dibbaṃ, upapajji sukataphalavipākam'anubhutvā, kanakatanusannibho idh'ābhibhavati, suravarataro'r'iva indo.

13707.meaning1: here friend; now brothers; in this case brethren

examples.text: idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassan'ānuggahitā ca hoti.

idh'āvuso satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti, yesañ'ca dhammānaṃ satthā pahānam'āha, te ca dhamme nappajahanti, bāhulikā ca honti, sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā
paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena. idh'āhaṃ bhikkhū paṭipucchissāmī'ti.
idh'āhaṃ, bhante, yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti?

13709.meaning1: with regard to that I; in that matter I

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, ārādhayiṃsu vata me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū ekaṃ samayaṃ cittaṃ. idh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū āmantesiṃ, ahaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjāmi.
katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.

13710.meaning1: with presence of mind right here; attending mindfully here and now

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīro idh'upaṭṭhitassatī, kāme ca pāpe ca asevamāno, sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, paṭisotagāmī'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ.

13712.commentary: (VINa) corā vattabbā manussā idh'ūpacarantī'ti kasmā vattabbaṃ? attano upaṭṭhākehi amhe gaṇhāpentī'ti vacana-paṭimocan'atthaṃ.

examples.text: sace sāsaṅkaṃ hoti, sāsaṅkan'ti ācikkhitabbaṃ, sace sappaṭibhayaṃ hoti, sappaṭibhayan'ti ācikkhitabbaṃ, sace, hotu, bhante, āhariyissatī'ti bhaṇati, corā vattabbā, manussā idh'ūpacaranti apasakkathā'ti.

13713.commentary: (VINa) idh'ūpapanno'ti idha mahāmāyāya deviyā kucchimhi nibbatto. (ITIa) idh'ūpapanno'ti idha imasmiṃ carimabhave manusso hutvā upapanno nibbatto.

examples.text: atthi kho, brahme, ābhassarā nāma kāyo yato tvaṃ cuto idh'ūpapanno. tassa te aticiranivāsena sā sati pamuṭṭhā, tena taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi passāmi.
tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti.

atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca, kahaṃ nu kho, bho, eta'r'ahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati? tañ'hi mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya idh'ūpasaṅkantā'ti.

13715.meaning1: here one; here a certain; in this case some; some people here

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

evam'eva kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, idh'ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi, tath'āyaṃ puggalo paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissatī'ti.

13716.meaning1: right here; just here; only here

examples.text: surāmerayapānañ'ca, yo naro anuyuñjati, idh'eva'm'eso lokasmiṃ, mūlaṃ khaṇati attano.
evaṃvihārī sato appamatto, bhikkhu caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, idh'eva vidvā pajaheyya dukkhaṃ.
idh'ev'āhaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessāmī'ti. assosuṃ kho jānapadā bhikkhū, bhagavā kira tatth'eva sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessatī'ti.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ etadavoca, tikiccha maṃ devānam'indā'ti

13719.meaning1: god Inda; king of the gods
13719.meaning2: Vedic god Inda, king of devas

examples.text: eko'va indo asure jināti, eko'va seno hanti dije pasayha, eko'va byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañ'hi tādisaṃ.

13720.commentary: (SNa) indakassā'ti indakūṭanivāsino yakkhassa. yakkhato hi kūṭena, kūṭato ca yakkhena nāmaṃ laddhaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati indakūṭe pabbate, indakassa yakkhassa bhavane. atha kho indako yakkho yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati indakūṭe pabbate, indakassa yakkhassa bhavane.

13724.meaning1: (of a city) Inda's column; gate post of a city
13724.meaning2: strong post before a city gate
13724.commentary: (SNPa) indakhīlo'ti nagaradvāranivāraṇ'atthaṃ ummār'abbhantare aṭṭha vā dasa vā hatthe pathaviṃ khaṇitvā ākoṭitassa sāradārumayathambhass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: yath'indakhīlo pathavissito siyā, catubbhi vātehi asampakampiyo, tath'ūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi, yo ariyasaccāni avecca passati, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīla-upamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.
yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddh'ābhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

13728.meaning1: cochineal; red dye made of the dried bodies of female cochineal insects
13728.meaning2: kind of red insects which come out from the ground after a rain fall
13728.commentary: (THa) indagopakasañchannā'ti indagopakanāmakehi pavāḷavaṇṇehi rattakimīhi sañchāditā pāvussakālavasena evam'āha. keci pana indagopakanāmāni rattatiṇānī'ti vadanti. apare kaṇikārarukkhā'ti.

examples.text: sā ahosi kuṭikā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā lohitikā, seyyathā'pi indagopako. seyyathā'pi nāma kiṅkaṇikasaddo evam'evaṃ tassā kuṭikāya saddo ahosi.

13729.meaning2: (according to commentaries) covered with red grass

examples.text: ekacce pana indajālena aṭṭhidhovanaṃ dhovanan'ti'pi vadanti.
puttā'pi tassa bahavo, indanāmā mahabbalā, iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

13736.meaning2: who has the same family clan as Inda

13739.commentary: (DNa) indasālaguhāyan'ti pubbe'pi sā dvinnaṃ pabbatānaṃ antare guhā, indasālarukkho c'assā dvāre, tasmā indasālaguhā'ti saṅkhyaṃ gatā. atha naṃ kuṭṭehi parikkhipitvā dvāravātapānāni yojetvā supariniṭṭhita-sudhākamma-mālākamma-latākamma-vicittaṃ leṇaṃ katvā bhagavato adaṃsu. purimavohāra-vasena pana indasālaguhā' tv'eva naṃ sañjānanti. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ indasālaguhāyan'ti.

examples.text: addasā kho sakko devānam'indo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass'uttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va hut'āsanaṃ.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, indriyesu guttadvārā viharatha.
vippasannāni kho te, gahapati, indriyāni, parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.

13744.meaning2: with a faculty; with a sense

examples.text: vīrā vīrehi dhammehi, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, dhārehi antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.

13745.meaning1: with faculties guarded; with senses protected

examples.text: kulākulaṃ piṇḍikāya caranto, indriyagutto nipako satīmā, sevetha pantāni sen'āsanāni, bhayā pamutto abhaye vimutto.

13746.meaning1: guarding the senses; keep watch over the faculties

examples.text: tatr'āyam'ādi bhavati, idha paññassa bhikkhuno, indriyagutti santuṭṭhi, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro.

13748.meaning2: sate of different degrees of development of the faculties

13750.meaning1: superior or inferior state of the faculties (of); good or bad mental condition
13750.commentary: (ANa) indriyaparopariyattan'ti saddh'ādīnaṃ indriyānaṃ parabhāvañ'ca aparabhāvañ'ca, vuddhiñ'ca hāniñ'cā'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ indriyaparopariyattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

13751.meaningLit: discourse on the superior or inferior state of the faculties

13752.meaning1: knowledge of the superior or inferior state of the faculties (of); understanding of the good or bad condition of the faculties

examples.text: ath'evaṃ diṭṭh'ādhimuttīnaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ indriyaparopariyattiñāṇena indriyaparopariyattaṃ passati saddh'ādīnaṃ tikkhamudubhāvadassanato.

13753.meaning1: mental faculties, power and factors of awakening
13753.construction:
indriya + bala + bojjhaṅga + ā
indriyabalabojjhaṅga + ā

13754.meaning1: development of the sense faculties; mental development

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hoti?

13755.meaningLit: discourse on development of the sense faculties

examples.text: ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā, satta devā

13757.meaning1: mentally accomplished; equipped with the faculty; with the ability

examples.text: sa ve indriyasampanno, santo santipade rato, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.

13758.meaningLit: discourse on accomplished in the sense faculties

13760.meaning1: control of the mind; sense restraint

examples.text: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato, imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajiṃ

13761.meaning1: who has achieved control of the mind; who has succeeded in sense restraint

13764.meaning1: who has failed to control the mind; who has erred in sense restraint

13770.meaning1: difference of faculties; diversity of capabilities

examples.text: eso ce, bhante, maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya, atha kiñ'carahi idh'ekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttino'ti? ettha kho pan'es'āhaṃ, ānanda, indriyavemattataṃ vadāmī'ti.

13771.meaning1: not restraining the senses; not controlling the mind

examples.text: ko c'āhāro tiṇṇaṃ duccaritānaṃ? indriyāsaṃvaro'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ. indriyāsaṃvaram'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro indriyāsaṃvarassa? asat'āsampajaññan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ
pāpamittatā sīlānaṃ paripantho, indriyāsaṃvaro brahmacariyassa paripantho, visaṃvādanā mittānaṃ paripantho

13772.meaning1: calmness of the mental faculties; peace of mind

examples.text: dussamādahaṃ vā'pi samādahanti, indriy'ūpasame ratā, te chetvā maccuno jālaṃ, ariyā gacchanti kāmadā'ti.
pariḷāhehī'ti paridāhehi. pariḍayhamāne'ti indhanaṃ viya agginā samantato ḍayhamāne.
evam'ev'ime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupād'āpaccā, jhāyino'smā jhāyino'smā'ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ paṭhamaṃ sakyesu ibbhavādaṃ nipātesi.
so imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ imāhi gāthāhi abhiṇhaṃ ovadatī'ti
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sace tumhe'pi na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha, na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha, na majjhe saṃsīdissatha, na thale ussīdissatha

13781.synonym: etañca, cidaṃ, cimaṃ, cetaṃ, cesa, ceso, panesā

examples.text: yasmiṃ kho, vaccha, samaye imañ'ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti, tam'ahaṃ taṇh'ūpādānaṃ vadāmi. taṇhā hi'ssa, vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī'ti.
imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.
viditañ'hi, bhante, tassa purisassa imañ'c'āhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchissāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti.
so evaṃ pajānāti, imañ'ce ahaṃ upekkhaṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasaṃhareyyaṃ, tadanudhammañ'ca cittaṃ bhāveyyaṃ.

13784.meaning1: this very; this exact same; this here

examples.text: bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho my'āyaṃ sukhā vedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no appaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca? imam'eva kāyaṃ paṭicca.

13785.grammar: pron, masc & nt abl sg of ima

examples.text: kīva dūr'ev'ime, bhikkhave, moghapurisā apakkantā imamhā dhammavinayā.
kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

13786.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ima

examples.text: imamhi ce, bhikkhave, samaye uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo kālaṅ'kareyya, n'atthi saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyā'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, imamhi c'āhaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyyaṃ, kā mayhaṃ gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

13787.grammar: pron, masc & nt abl sg of ima

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sunakkhatto licchaviputto acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā.

13788.meaning1: and in this; and in regard to this; and when this
13788.commentary: (SNa) imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye'ti attano saviññāṇakakāyaṃ dasseti, bahiddhā cā'ti parassa saviññāṇakaṃ vā aviññāṇakaṃ vā.

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu

13789.meaning1: in this very; in this exact

examples.text: khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.
sakkā nu kho, bho gotama, imasmim'pi dhammavinaye evam'eva anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññapetun'ti

13791.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ima

examples.text: atha kho pāyāsi rājañño uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca, saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi, imin'āhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññam'eva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin'ti
sattaṭṭhānakusalo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso'ti vuccati.

13792.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ima, loc abs

examples.text: idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti. imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsū'ti.
iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass'uppādā idaṃ uppajjati, imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati

13793.meaning1: in this very; in this exact

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷevare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

sace hi ayaṃ paṭhamavaye bhoge akhepetvā kamm'ante payojayissa, imasmiṃ'y'eva nagare aggaseṭṭhi abhavissa. sace pana nikkhamitvā pabbajissa, arahattaṃ pāpuṇissa, bhariyā'pi'ssa anāgāmiphale patiṭṭhahissa.

13794.grammar: pron, masc dat sg of ima

examples.text: gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.
imassa pana te, māgaṇḍiya, kim'assa vacanīyan'ti? na kiñci, bho gotama.

13795.grammar: pron, masc gen sg of ima

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
imassa nu kho, sāriputta, saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo'ti? evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto tuṇhī ahosi.

13796.meaning1: from the arising of this; when this arises

examples.text: iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass'uppādā idaṃ uppajjati. imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati
gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.

13798.grammar: pron, masc fem & nt acc sg of ima

examples.text: atha kassa c'āhaṃ, bho gotama, imaṃ pāyasaṃ dammī'ti?
hitvā icchañ'ca lobhañ'ca, yattha satto puthujjano, cakkhumā paṭipajjeyya, tareyya narakaṃ imaṃ.
ahu pana te, bhāradvāja, māgaṇḍiyena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ'y'eva tiṇasanthārakaṃ ārabbha koci'd'eva kathāsallāpo'ti?
sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako imaṃ'y'eva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyath'idaṃ, ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo…
